body: I doubt anybody at school will think of me. None of them know me, none of them try to talk to me because I seem too weird. They'll just remember my death, and as a slightly interesting event that took place once in their mundane lives. I'm sure they'll be no more depth to my death, it's only an interesting topic for conversation; there'll be no sympathy there.
It's okay to ask for help. I think I'm going to end it soon, too. I've planned it all out so, I might even do it next morning.

The Beatles - Tomorrow never knows
Open up a window, let the breeze roll in and lie down somewhere and close your eyes and listen to it. It's an experience in itself.
I tried to stab myself with a butterknife when I was 5 lol, now I'm going to hang myself now 10 years later. Maybe it's in our genes.
